required.asked_by: what made the SSH connection fail
required.rationale: the cause the job log states inside the UNREACHABLE message; an agent that reads only the last line sees just 'Permission denied (publickey)'

required.asked_by: which task in the content set that up
required.rationale: the log names the task and role that wrote the key file; the UNREACHABLE play does not

any_of: readable only by the file owner
required.asked_by: what should change in that task
required.rationale: the remedy: a private key mode that ssh accepts, set in the task that wrote the key
required.note: the fetched tasks/main.yml writes the key with mode "0644" and the job log shows ssh refusing a key with permissions 0644 as too open; ssh accepts a private key only when it is not readable by group or others, so the line must become 0600 or 0400 (owner-only).

citations.rationale: the line number is counted from the seeded task file; the log names the task's first line (10), not the mode line, so only the fetch supplies it

none_of: key is not authorized on the bastion
key isn't authorized on the bastion
forbidden.rationale: ssh never offered the key, so the bastion never judged it; blaming the bastion's authorized_keys or the EC2 key pair is the reading of 'Permission denied (publickey)' that the earlier lines of the same message refute
